## project/.codex/plugins/aidd-context/hooks/hooks.json
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/update_memory.js"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Write|Edit|MultiEdit|Bash|Shell|bash|powershell",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/memory-hook.cjs",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}

## project/.codex/plugins/aidd-telemetry/hooks/hooks.json

  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.cjs",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/catch-up.cjs",
            "async": true,
            "timeout": 120
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "node ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/prompt-gate.cjs",
            "timeout": 30
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
